exposure: Newborn weight loss during birth hospitalization
Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: 83,344 newborns exclusively breastfed during birth hospitalization at Kaiser Permanente Northern California hospitals between 2009 and 2013
finding: Among newborns exclusively breastfed during birth hospitalization, greater weight loss was associated with a higher risk of cessation of exclusive breastfeeding, but not overall cessation of breastfeeding.
